auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/10/6), with 7 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 14 · Craft 6 · Talk 12 · Explore 31 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Vivaan Rao ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
